title: PropFlow — choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Field Planner. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Field Planner
options.lineage: Keller Williams time-block planner, rent receipts, goal trackers
options.thesis: The agent's working planner, printed and inked: every number sits against a goal and every state is carried in ink.
options.viewport: Left rail inked as manila tabs, one stationery hue per section; the dashboard opens as today's sheet — date stamp, ruled KPI cells with ticker figures and goal-vs-actual inked meters, revenue drawn on graph dots, attention items rubber-stamped.
options.risk: Reads cozy unless density holds; sits near the warm-paper AI default if the four-ink system goes timid.

regions.label: tab rail — one ink-hue per section
today header + date stamp + primary action
ruled KPI cells w/ goal-vs-actual meters

raised.raise: One stationery hue per feature area, carried consistently through the tab rail, section headers, and stamps.
State carried in form, not hue alone: overdue = dashed stroke, pending = half-height, won = doubled line.
Grid courage: strict 8pt column discipline, full-bleed rules, tables allowed their true density.
Comfort discipline: 44px targets, plain-language labels, action color only where something can be done.
Focus isolation: an expanded row dims its neighbors one step.

options.label: The Drafting Table
options.lineage: architect's drawing sets, vellum, title blocks
options.thesis: The portfolio as a drawing set: every surface a sheet on the drafting table, annotated and dimensioned.
options.viewport: A title-block header (project, sheet no., revision); KPIs read as dimensioned figures with leader-line callouts; properties rendered as hatched plan views; nav as the sheet index.
options.risk: Blueprint aesthetics are the property category's favorite costume — earns its place only at full drafting commitment, and the cool palette reads distant for daily ops.

options.label: The Operating Binder
options.lineage: boxed-software reference manuals, acetate leaves, tab rails
options.thesis: PropFlow as the office's well-kept binder: every feature a tabbed section on a full-strength hue board.
options.viewport: A stepped tab rail down the left edge with one full-strength hue per division; the open section's hue becomes the board the work sits on.
options.case: Fuses cleanly — features map to tabbed divisions and the section-hue system is the strongest wayfinding story; loses narrowly on warmth for daily use.
options.risk: Reads retro-novelty if the tab rail decorates instead of navigating.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.case: Fuses poorly — it is the incumbent look and the category default; the canon card already owns this lane.
options.kept: Comfort discipline: 44px targets, plain-language labels, action color only where something can be done.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.case: Fuses poorly — the visible construction grid reads as a design-tool portfolio, not a working property tool.
options.kept: Grid courage: strict column discipline and full-bleed rules.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.case: Fuses poorly — an instrument costume on a working screen; operators do not identify with lab benches.
options.kept: State-as-form discipline: state in dash, height, and doubling, never hue alone.

options.label: Streaming Wall
options.case: Fuses poorly — properties as poster tiles is a listing-site costume, wrong register for operations.
options.kept: Focus isolation: the active row lifts while neighbors dim.

options.label: Mixtape J-Card
options.case: Fuses poorly — music ephemera shares the planner's handwriting but no property resonance.
options.kept: Right-aligned tabular figures, tight against the margin.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The clean SaaS admin — sidebar, soft cards, one blue — executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement every visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
